description: Generated registry members with no reader yet (scripts/registry-readers.mjs, run by gen-registries --check). Each entry names why and the issue that removes it. An entry that gains a reader fails the check, so this list only shrinks. The kotlin lane also accepts `Object.*` for a catalog that Android reads member by member as features ship. An optional `ships` lane, keyed `<platform>:<featureId>`, excuses a capabilities.json ships or partial claim whose registry entries no source on that platform reads (#285).

RegistryTaskPageBlockIds.*.reason: Android renders taskPage.blocks by kind (ADR 0029, #305) and reads no block by its ID.

RegistrySurfaceIds.*.reason: Android reads top-level surfaces as their screens ship; the rest still name their ID as a literal.

RegistryActionIds.*.reason: Android implements a subset of the registry; members gain readers as features ship (ADR 0028). Actions and menus.

RegistryCapabilityIds.*.reason: Android implements a subset of the registry; members gain readers as features ship (ADR 0028). A ships claim with no reader is checked by #285.

RegistryIconIds.*.reason: Android draws Material icons chosen in code; it does not read the registry icon map yet.

RegistrySettingKeys.*.reason: Android has no Settings surface yet.

RegistryPromptIds.*.reason: Android implements a subset of the registry; members gain readers as features ship (ADR 0028). Delete and account prompts.

RegistryFirstRunStepIds.*.reason: Android has no first-run flow yet; it reads only the done step.

RegistryTaskAttributeIds.*.reason: Android implements a subset of the registry; members gain readers as features ship (ADR 0028). Reminder, star, discuss and paste attributes.

RegistryPlatformIds.*.reason: Android reads only its own platform ID; the others exist for the capability table.
